parameters.content: Inactive draft. Imports Shopify fulfilled orders, records Shopify and Shopify Fulfillment Events through Supabase RPC shipping_record_tracking_event, then evaluates active shipments through shipping_evaluate_shipment. Supabase is source of truth; dashboard/API is not required for the agent run. DPD/DHL direct carrier polling remains Phase 2 after credentials and rate limits are verified.

nodes.name: Supabase RPC: Record Shopify Shipment Event

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ query: `query ShippingFulfillmentEvents($id: ID!) { fulfillment(id: $id) { id status displayStatus deliveredAt inTransitAt estimatedDeliveryAt trackingInfo(first: 10) { company number url } events(first: 20, reverse: true) { edges { node { id status message happenedAt createdAt estimatedDeliveryAt address1 city province country zip latitude longitude } } } } }`, variables: { id: 'gid://shopify/Fulfillment/' + $('Build Shipment Records').item.json.shipment.shopifyFulfillmentId } }) }}
